words.tr: phrase. 闲聊；寒暄；无关紧要的谈话
words.ex: He makes small talk with his neighbors every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上和邻居闲聊。
words.en: Small talk is polite conversation about unimportant or uncontroversial matters, especially as engaged in on social occasions.

words.ex: He wore jeans to the informal party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着牛仔裤去参加非正式的聚会。
words.en: If you describe something as informal, you mean that it is not done or said in a formal or official way.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.ex: She answered the question confidently.
words.ex_cn: 她自信地回答了问题。
words.en: If you do something confidently, you do it in a way that shows you are sure of what you're doing or saying.

words.tr: phrase. 交朋友；建立友谊；与人结交
words.ex: He wants to make friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在学校交朋友。
words.en: To establish a relationship of mutual affection with someone, typically one that is not a romantic or family relationship.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到紧张的；对……感到焦虑的
words.ex_cn: 他对于数学考试感到紧张。
words.en: To feel anxious or worried about something that is going to happen or might happen.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到紧张的；对……焦虑不安的
words.ex: She was nervous about the interview.
words.ex_cn: 她对面试感到紧张。
words.en: Feeling or showing anxiety or worry about something.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 点头；打盹
n. 点头
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否累了时，他点了点头。
words.en: If you nod, you move your head downwards and upwards to show that you are answering 'yes' to a question, or to show agreement, understanding, or approval.

words.tr: phrase. 身体语言；肢体语言
words.ex: He smiles and nods, that is positive body language.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑并点头，这是积极的肢体语言。
words.en: The conscious and unconscious movements and postures by which attitudes and feelings are communicated.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.tr:
v. 叹息；叹气
n. 叹息；叹气
words.ex: He sighed when he saw the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 他看到凌乱的房间时叹了口气。
words.en: To sigh is to let out a deep breath slowly and audibly, often as a sign of sadness, tiredness, or relief.

words.tr: phrase. 把目光从…移开；避开…的视线
words.ex: He had to look away from the gruesome scene.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不把目光从这可怕的场景移开。
words.en: To deliberately turn one's gaze away from someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 社会规则；社交规范
words.ex: Children learn social rules at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习社交规则。
words.en: Social rules are the norms and guidelines that govern behavior in society, ensuring social order and cohesion.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: Immigration to this country has increased recently.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的移民数量最近增加了。
words.en: Immigration is the act of coming to live permanently in a country that is not your own.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.tr: adj. 不礼貌的；无礼的；粗鲁的；
words.ex: He said hello without smiling, which was impolite.
words.ex_cn: 他打招呼时没有微笑，这是不礼貌的。
words.en: If you say that someone is impolite, you mean that they are rather rude and do not have good manners.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.tr:
n. 喜爱；赞同；
v. 赞成；偏爱；有利于；
words.ex: He has a favour for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他特别喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.tr: n. 女售货员；女营业员；
words.ex: The saleswoman helped me choose a dress.
words.ex_cn: 女售货员帮我挑选了一条裙子。
words.en: A saleswoman is a woman whose job is to sell products or services in a store or directly to customers.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.tr: adj. 直言无讳的；坦率的；
words.ex: He is an outspoken teacher who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位直言不讳的老师，总是说真话。
words.en: Someone who is outspoken expresses their opinions frankly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

words.ex: Every human being deserves respect.
words.ex_cn: 每一个人都应得到尊重。
words.en: A human being is a man, woman, or child.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.w: put one's foot in one's mouth
words.tr: phrase. （因说错话而）使人尴尬；说错话；祸从口出
words.uk: pʊt wʌnz fʊt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.us: pʊt wʌnz fʊt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.ex: He put his foot in his mouth when he called his teacher 'mom'.
words.ex_cn: 他把老师叫成“妈妈”时，说错了话。
words.en: To say something that is embarrassing, wrong, or foolish, especially in a social situation.

words.ex: His main shortcoming is being late often.
words.ex_cn: 他的主要缺点是经常迟到。
words.en: A shortcoming is a fault or a failure to meet a certain standard, which means a person or thing is not as good as they should be.

words.ex: His absence of interest made the teacher sad.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习的缺乏兴趣让老师感到难过。
words.en: The state of being away from a place or person.

words.ex: He didn't study, as a consequence, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，结果考试没及格。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.ex: He follows a systematic approach to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种系统的方法来解决数学问题。
words.en: A systematic approach or method is one that is done according to a fixed plan, in a thorough and efficient way.

words.ex: It's a coincidence that we both wore blue today.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天都穿了蓝色，真是巧合。
words.en: A coincidence is when two or more similar or related events occur at the same time by chance and without any planning.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.ex: They tease him because he wears funny hats.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他戴滑稽的帽子而戏弄他。
words.en: To tease someone means to make fun of them or try to provoke them in a playful way.

words.ex: She is a fast typist.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位打字很快的打字员。
words.en: A typist is someone who types, especially as their job.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: He was cautious when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时很小心。
words.en: If you are cautious, you are careful and avoid taking risks.

words.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。
words.en: An acquaintance is someone you know a little, who is not a close friend.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人振作起来；让某人高兴起来
words.ex: A good joke can really cheer sb. up.
words.ex_cn: 一个好笑话真的可以让人振奋。
words.en: To make someone feel happier or more optimistic.

words.tr:
n. 傻瓜；蠢人；
v. 愚弄；
words.ex: He is a fool for spending all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜，把所有钱都花在游戏上了。
words.en: A fool is someone who behaves in a silly way without thinking or someone who is tricked into believing or doing something that is not sensible.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.ex: He got a new haircut yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天理了一个新发型。
words.en: The act or process of cutting the hair.

words.tr: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: I don't like it, but I'll do it anyhow.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，但我还是会做。
words.en: in whatever way or manner; regardless of how

words.tr: adj. 不多的；适度的；谦虚的；
words.ex: He made a modest profit last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年的利润不多。
words.en: If you say that someone is modest, you approve of them because they do not talk much about their abilities or achievements.

words.tr: n. 早午餐（早午两餐并作一餐）
words.ex: We had brunch at a small café on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去一家小咖啡馆吃早午餐。
words.en: Brunch is a meal that is eaten in the late morning. It is a combination of breakfast and lunch.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.tr: n. 女主人；女房东；女招待；女主持人；
words.ex: The hostess welcomed us with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 女主人微笑着欢迎我们。
words.en: A woman who receives or entertains guests in a social or official capacity; a woman who is in charge of a particular event or place and who welcomes and looks after the people who attend.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 省去； 遗漏； 不考虑
words.ex: Don't leave out the sugar in the recipe.
words.ex_cn: 别在食谱里漏掉糖。
words.en: To not include someone or something in an activity or discussion.

words.tr: adj. 根据事实的；真实的；
words.ex: His report is factual and accurate.
words.ex_cn: 他的报告是基于事实且准确的。
words.en: If something is factual, it is based on facts or concerns facts.

words.ex: This is a genuine diamond.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石。
words.en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.ex: The climate is hospitable for growing oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这种气候适合种植橙子。
words.en: If someone is hospitable, they are friendly, welcoming, and generous to guests or strangers.

words.tr: adj. 遮遮掩掩的；守口如瓶的；
words.ex: He gave a secretive smile and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他露出一个遮遮掩掩的微笑，然后走开了。
words.en: If you are secretive, you like to have secrets and to keep your knowledge, feelings, or intentions hidden.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；觉察到；知道
words.ex: He is aware of the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他aware of规则。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.ex: Tom takes the lead in the race.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆在比赛中领先。
words.en: To be in the leading position in a competition, race, or any activity.

words.tr: adv. 慈祥地；优雅地；优裕地
words.ex: She smiled graciously at the child.
words.ex_cn: 她慈祥地对那个孩子微笑了。
words.en: In a manner that is characterized by charm, good taste, and generosity of spirit.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: He apologised for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉了。
words.en: To say that you are sorry for something that you have done, especially something that has caused inconvenience or upset someone.

words.ex: He watched the whole series of the show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完了这部剧的整个系列。
words.en: A series of things or events is a number of them that come one after the other.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.ex: He used a spyglass to get a better view of the distant ship.
words.ex_cn: 他使用小望远镜以便更好地观察远处的船只。
words.en: A small telescope used for viewing distant objects.

words.ex: The heroine saves the town from the dragon.
words.ex_cn: 女主角拯救了小镇免受龙的侵害。
words.en: A heroine is a woman who is admired for her courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities, especially a woman who has performed a heroic act or is the main character in a story.

words.ex: The firefighter is a hero for saving the child.
words.ex_cn: 消防员救了孩子，是个英雄。
words.en: A hero is a person who is admired for their courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 在……中起重要作用；在……中扮演重要角色
words.ex: Water plays an important part in keeping our body healthy.
words.ex_cn: 水在保持我们身体健康方面起着重要作用。
words.en: To have a significant role or effect in a particular situation or activity.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: He gave a philosophical answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个哲学性的回答。
words.en: Relating to or based on philosophy; calm and thoughtful in the face of problems.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: The cat hid behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫躲到了灌木丛后面。
words.en: A bush is a plant which is much smaller than a tree and has a lot of branches.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.tr:
n. 指关节
v. 用指关节…；屈从
words.ex: He cracked his knuckles before the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛前掰响了指关节。
words.en: The knuckles are the joints of the fingers, especially where they join the hand.

words.tr:
n. 咬；咬伤；上钩；
v. 咬；叮；上钩；
words.ex: The dog gave him a sudden bite.
words.ex_cn: 狗突然咬了他一口。
words.en: If an animal or person bites you, they use their teeth to cut into your flesh.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.tr: v. 木然; 使发呆，使昏昏沉沉( stupefy的过去式和过去分词 ); 使惊讶
words.ex: She was left stupefied by the news.
words.ex_cn: 她被这个消息惊呆了。
words.en: If someone is stupefied, they are so surprised or shocked that they cannot think properly.

words.tr: n. 枯竭；耗尽；筋疲力尽；
words.ex: The long hike led to his exhaustion.
words.ex_cn: 长时间的徒步旅行导致他筋疲力尽。
words.en: A state of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.tr: n. 平纹，斑猫 v. 使起波纹 adj. 平纹织物的，起波纹的
words.ex: She wore a dress made of tabby fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件用平纹织物做的裙子。
words.en: A tabby is a cat with a distinctive coat that features stripes, dots, or swirling patterns, often with a mark resembling an 'M' on its forehead.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；提供；坚持；抵抗；寄予（希望）
words.ex: He held out his hand to help her up.
words.ex_cn: 他伸出手帮她起来。
words.en: If you hold out your hand or something you have in your hand, you move your hand away from your body, usually to offer something to someone else.

words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；热望
adj. 渴望的；热望的
v. 渴望；热望；“long”的现在分词
v. 用练马绳训练马的各种步态
words.ex: Her longing for home grew stronger each day.
words.ex_cn: 她对家的渴望与日俱增。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 烫伤；烫洗
n. 烫伤；烫洗
words.ex: He scalded his hand on the hot pot.
words.ex_cn: 他被热锅烫伤了手。
words.en: To scald means to burn the skin with boiling liquid or steam. It can also refer to the injury caused by such an action.

words.tr: phrase. 转身离开；拒绝进入；把脸转开
words.ex: The guard will turn away anyone without a ticket.
words.ex_cn: 没有票的人，警卫都会拒之门外。
words.en: If you turn someone away, you do not allow them to enter a place or join an organization, often because there is no room for them or because they are not suitable.

words.tr:
n. 巡逻
v. 巡逻
words.ex: The police patrol the street at night.
words.ex_cn: 警察晚上在街上巡逻。
words.en: A patrol is a group of soldiers or vehicles that are guarding a place at a particular time. Patrol can also refer to the act of moving around an area or building at regular times to check that it is safe.

words.tr: n. 鹅耳枥; 角树，角树材
words.ex: The hornbeam tree is known for its hard, durable wood.
words.ex_cn: 鹅耳枥树以其坚硬耐用的木材而闻名。
words.en: A hornbeam is a type of tree with hard, heavy wood, belonging to the genus Carpinus in the family Betulaceae.

words.ex: The cat licked its paw.
words.ex_cn: 猫舔它的爪子。
words.en: The foot of an animal that has claws or nails, such as a cat, dog, or bear.

words.tr:
n. 轻拍；
v. 轻拍；
words.ex: He gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻拍了拍狗的头。
words.en: To gently touch someone or something with your hand flat.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.tr: adv. 僵硬地；顽固地；呆板地
words.ex: He stood stiffly in the corner.
words.ex_cn: 他僵硬地站在角落里。
words.en: In a stiff manner; rigidly or formally.

words.tr: adv. 提高警觉地，留意地
words.ex: She listened alertly to the conversation, trying to catch every detail.
words.ex_cn: 她警觉地听着对话，试图捕捉每一个细节。
words.en: In a way that shows you are quick to notice any unusual or potentially dangerous situation.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: He gave a sniff of the flower.
words.ex_cn: 他闻了闻那朵花。
words.en: To sniff is to breathe in air through your nose in a way that makes a noise, especially when you are trying to smell something or when you have a cold.

words.tr: n. 细须；连鬓胡子；略微
words.ex: The cat's whisker touched the edge of the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 猫的细须碰到了碗的边缘。
words.en: A whisker is one of the long stiff hairs that grow near the mouth of a cat, mouse, or other mammal.

words.ex: He twitched the rope to pull the box closer.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把箱子拉近了些。
words.en: To make a sudden, small movement with a part of your body, especially because you are nervous or in pain.

words.ex: He showed wariness when talking to strangers.
words.ex_cn: 他和陌生人交谈时表现出谨慎。
words.en: Wariness is the feeling or state of being cautious about possible dangers or problems.

words.ex: He nodded in a blink.
words.ex_cn: 他一眨眼就点了点头。
words.en: To shut and open the eyes quickly, typically involuntarily.

words.tr: phrase. （情感、感觉等）突然袭来；席卷
words.ex: A feeling of happiness swept over her when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，一种幸福的感觉涌上心头。
words.en: To spread quickly and affect many people or a large area.

words.tr: phrase. 紧盯着；密切注意；持续关注
words.ex: Keep your eyes on the ball when you are playing tennis.
words.ex_cn: 打网球时要盯着球。
words.en: To watch someone or something closely; to pay close attention to someone or something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 决定；选定；专注于
words.ex: I finally fixed on a color for my room.
words.ex_cn: 我最终决定了房间的颜色。
words.en: If you fix on a particular thing, you decide that it is the one you want or will have.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 尤其用于英式英语，意为四处寻找，想办法，思考对策
words.ex: He cast about for a solution to the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他四处寻找解决问题的办法。
words.en: To search or look for something in a wide or random manner.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.ex: He was profoundly moved by the music.
words.ex_cn: 他被音乐深深打动了。
words.en: In a profound manner; deeply.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.ex: The shop tries to entice customers with cheap prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店试图以低价吸引顾客。
words.en: If you entice someone, you attract them to a particular place or activity by making it seem attractive or interesting.

words.tr:
v. 弯腰；俯身；卑屈；俯冲
n. 弯腰；屈背；屈服；俯冲
words.ex: He must stoop to enter the small door.
words.ex_cn: 他必须弯腰才能进入那扇小门。
words.en: If someone stoops, they bend their body forwards and downwards.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.tr:
v. 重击；捶击；发撞击声
n. 重击声；重打
words.ex: He thumped the table with his fist.
words.ex_cn: 他用拳头重击了桌子。
words.en: If you thump something, you hit it hard, usually with your fist.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: He walked down the wide boulevard with many shops.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着满是商店的宽阔大马路散步。
words.en: A boulevard is a wide street in a city, usually with trees along the sides.

words.ex: He was utterly surprised by the news.
words.ex_cn: 他全然没想到这个消息。
words.en: completely or totally

words.tr: phrase. 充满……的；负载着……的；装满……的
words.ex: The streets were laden with the scent of blooming flowers.
words.ex_cn: 街道上充满了盛开的花朵的香气。
words.en: If someone or something is laden with a lot of heavy things, they are holding or carrying them.

words.tr: phrase. 充满…的；满载…的；负担着…的
words.ex: The ship was laden with precious cargo.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船装满了贵重货物。
words.en: If something is laden with a particular thing, it has a lot of that thing in it or on it.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr: n. 公园绿地；公用场地；
words.ex: The children play in the parkland after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园绿地里玩耍。
words.en: Parkland refers to land that is designated or used as a park, typically characterized by its green, open spaces and recreational facilities.

words.ex: The children played in a small grove behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的小树林里玩耍。
words.en: A grove is a small group of trees.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.ex: The tree has bare branches in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在冬天有光秃秃的树枝。
words.en: If part of your body is bare, it is not covered by any clothing.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: A shudder ran through her when she saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到蛇时，全身战栗了一下。
words.en: If you shudder, you shake with fear, horror, or disgust, or because you are cold.

words.tr:
n. 黎明；拂晓；开端
v. 破晓；开始明朗；“dawn”的现在分词
words.ex: The dawning of a new era in technology is upon us.
words.ex_cn: 一个技术新时代的黎明正降临在我们身上。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning or first appearance of something.

words.tr: n.头晕眼花; 头晕目眩
words.ex: The sudden light-headedness made her feel faint.
words.ex_cn: 突然的头晕眼花让她感到眩晕。
words.en: A feeling of dizziness or faintness, often caused by a lack of blood to the brain.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.tr: phrase. 四处寻找；到处搜寻
words.ex: He looks around for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都四处寻找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something in various places.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.ex: They will marry next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在明年夏天结婚。
words.en: To marry someone means to become their husband or wife in a legal or religious ceremony.

words.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
words.ex_cn: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wicked, you mean that they are very bad, immoral, or cruel.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.tr: phrase. 对…施咒；使…着魔；迷住；使神魂颠倒
words.ex: The witch put a spell on the prince, turning him into a frog.
words.ex_cn: 女巫对王子施了魔法，把他变成了一只青蛙。
words.en: To use magic to make something happen to someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher will punish the student for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师会因为作弊而惩罚那个学生。
words.en: To punish someone means to make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.ex: He loves reading literary books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读文学书籍。
words.en: Literary means concerned with or connected with the writing, study, or appreciation of literature.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: Schoolchildren walk to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学童每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: Schoolchildren are children who attend school.

words.ex: He typed the letter on an old typewriter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧打字机打了这封信。
words.en: A typewriter is a machine with keys that you press to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

words.ex: She is a stateswoman who helps her country.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位帮助国家的政治家。
words.en: A stateswoman is a female political leader who is experienced in the art of government or diplomacy.

words.tr: adj. 有才华的；有天赋的；
words.ex: He is a gifted musician who plays piano beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有才华的音乐家，钢琴弹得非常优美。
words.en: Having a natural ability or talent.

words.tr: n. 根；根源；根本；“root”的复数；
words.ex: The roots of the equation are 2 and 3.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程的根是2和3。
words.en: The underground parts of a plant that anchor it and absorb water and nutrients.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.tr: phrase. 和…联系在一起；与…有关
words.ex: He is associated with the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地医院有关联。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 与……有关的；和……联系在一起的
words.ex: The disease is associated with poor diet.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病与不良饮食有关。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected in some way.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: He told an anecdote about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的趣事。
words.en: An anecdote is a short, amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.ex: He is stubborn and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很顽固，不肯改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is stubborn is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.ex: He made an adjustment to live in the new city.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了适应以适应新城市的生活。
words.en: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: He received criticism for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而受到批评。
words.en: Criticism is the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something and of the faults they have or the mistakes they have made.

words.tr: 动词短语. 向某人呼吁；上诉；对某人有吸引力
words.ex: The idea of traveling around the world appeals to me.
words.ex_cn: 环游世界的想法吸引了我。
words.en: If something appeals to you, you find it attractive or interesting.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: adj. 受限制的；有限的； v. 限制；约束；“restrict”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children have restricted screen time.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的屏幕使用时间是受限制的。
words.en: If something is restricted, it is limited or controlled, especially by rules or laws.

words.tr: phrase. 仅限于；受限于；被限定在……之内
words.ex: The parking is restricted to residents only.
words.ex_cn: 这个停车场仅限于居民使用。
words.en: Limited to or confined within a specific area, group, or scope.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: He studied hard, thus he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: He is a billionaire who owns many companies.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位拥有许多公司的亿万富翁。
words.en: A billionaire is an extremely rich person who has money or property worth at least a billion dollars or pounds.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.

words.ex: You ought to finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你应当在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: You use 'ought' to indicate that it is morally right or advisable for someone to do something, or to indicate that it is probable that something is true or will happen.

words.ex: The inquisitive child asked many questions about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 这个好奇的孩子问了很多关于星星的问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as inquisitive, you mean that they are interested in a lot of different things and want to find out more about them.

words.ex: He looks back over his shoulder when he walks alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上独自走路时会回头看。
words.en: To glance backwards, often out of nostalgia or concern.

words.ex: I catch a glimpse of the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我瞥见了树上的鸟。
words.en: To see someone or something for a very short time.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr:
v. 嘎吱嘎吱地动；发嘎吱嘎吱声
n. 嘎吱声；艰难局面；危急情况
words.ex: The dog crunches the bone loudly.
words.ex_cn: 狗嘎吱嘎吱地咬着骨头。
words.en: To crunch means to chew noisily with your mouth open, or to make a loud noise like the sound of something being crushed. It can also refer to a critical point or situation, especially in financial contexts.

words.tr: n. 雨声，类似下雨的声
words.ex: The pitter-patter of rain on the roof was soothing.
words.ex_cn: 雨打在屋顶上的滴答声让人感到宁静。
words.en: The sound of a rapid succession of light beats or taps, as of raindrops or footsteps.

words.ex: The magazine has a glossy cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本杂志有一个光滑的封面。
words.en: Something that is glossy is smooth and shiny.

words.tr:
n. 小径；路径；踪迹；
v. 跟踪；尾随；落后于；
words.ex: We walked along the forest trail.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着森林小径散步。
words.en: A trail is a path through the countryside or through a forest, often made or used by people walking. As a verb, to trail means to follow someone or something secretly or to be behind in a race or competition.

words.ex: He wore a wool muffler in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他在冬天戴了一条羊毛围巾。
words.en: A muffler is a piece of cloth worn around the neck for warmth or a device used to reduce the noise emitted by an engine.

words.ex: She has curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有一头卷发。
words.en: Having curls or a curved shape.

words.tr: adj. 亲切的；和蔼的；仁慈的
words.ex: She was gracious and thanked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她很友善，感谢了每一个人。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially someone you think is superior to you, as gracious, you mean that they are very well-mannered and pleasant.

words.ex: He exclaim when he saw the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜时，他大喊起来。
words.en: If you exclaim, you say something suddenly and loudly, often because you are surprised, excited, or angry.

words.ex: The elf lives in a small tree house.
words.ex_cn: 精灵住在一间小树屋里。
words.en: In folklore, an elf is a type of supernatural being in Germanic mythology and folklore. Elves are often depicted as youthful-seeming men and women of great beauty living in forests and other natural places, underground, or in wells and springs.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: The fairy tale features a dwarf who lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这个童话故事中有一个住在小房子里的侏儒。
words.en: A dwarf is a person, animal, or plant that is much smaller than the usual size of its species. As a verb, to dwarf means to make someone or something seem small or insignificant in comparison.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们是亲密的朋友。
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr: phrase. 大声喊；突发；闯出来
words.ex: He burst out laughing when he heard the joke.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个笑话时突然大笑起来。
words.en: If you burst out doing something, you suddenly start doing it or saying it.

words.tr: phrase. 撞倒；打翻；抢劫（商店等）；使震惊
words.ex: The dog knocked over the vase and broke it.
words.ex_cn: 狗把花瓶撞倒了，打碎了。
words.en: To cause something to fall or topple by striking it.

words.ex: He is financially independent from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他在经济上独立于他的父母。
words.en: In a way that relates to money or how money is managed.

words.tr: adj. 喜怒无常的；情绪多变的；
words.ex: He is moody and changes his mind often.
words.ex_cn: 他喜怒无常，经常改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as moody, you mean that their feelings and behavior change frequently, and in particular that they often become depressed or angry without any warning.

words.tr: phrase. 对…失去兴趣；不再关心…
words.ex: He started to lose interest in his job after a few years.
words.ex_cn: 几年后，他对工作开始失去兴趣。
words.en: to stop being interested in something or someone

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.tr: phrase. （使）转身; （使）好转; 改变意见; 使变得完全不同
words.ex: He turned round when he heard his name.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到自己的名字时，他转过身来。
words.en: To change position so as to face in the opposite direction; to reverse one's opinion or the direction of something.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr:
adj. 公平的；相当大的；合理的；
n. 集市；
words.ex: The teacher gave a fair grade to every student.
words.ex_cn: 老师给每个学生都给了一个公平的分数。
words.en: Fair means treating people equally without favouritism or discrimination.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.ex: They are trying to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在努力为学校筹钱。
words.en: To collect money for a particular purpose, especially for a charity or for a political campaign.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr: phrase. 用电话交谈；在通话
words.ex: He is talking on the phone with his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和妈妈打电话。
words.en: Using the telephone to communicate with someone.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.tr:
v. 争吵；吵架；
n. 争吵；口角；
words.ex: They quarrel over small things every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天为小事争吵。
words.en: A quarrel is an angry argument or disagreement between people.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr:
n. 遗憾；
v. 懊悔；
words.ex: He felt a deep regret after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失去工作后感到深深的遗憾。
words.en: If you regret something that you have done, you wish that you had not done it.

words.ex: We should keep in touch even after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我们毕业后也应该保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone, especially after not seeing them for a period of time.

words.ex: He lost touch with his old friends after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到一个新城市后，和老朋友失去了联系。
words.en: To no longer communicate with someone or be informed about something.

words.tr: n. 糖果; 甜食; 糖果( sweet的名词复数 ); 甜味; [用复数]快乐
words.ex: He eats sweets after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃糖果。
words.en: Sweets are small sweet foods such as toffees, chocolates, and mints.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 对……感到羞愧；因……而内疚
words.ex: He is ashamed of his bad grades.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己糟糕的成绩感到羞愧。
words.en: To feel shame or guilt about something you have done or about a situation.

words.ex: He felt ashamed for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对妈妈撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: If someone is ashamed, they feel embarrassed or guilty because of something they have done or because of their appearance.

words.tr: v. 背叛；出卖；泄露；暴露
words.ex: He betrays his friend by telling the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他通过泄露秘密背叛了朋友。
words.en: If you betray someone who loves or trusts you, your actions hurt and disappoint them.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.ex: I forgive you for being late.
words.ex_cn: 我原谅你迟到了。
words.en: If you forgive someone who has done something bad or wrong, you stop being angry with them and stop blaming them.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.ex: My mom scolded me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而责备了我。
words.en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr: phrase. 被赋予；有幸拥有（某种天赋、品质或好处）
words.ex: She is blessed with a talent for music.
words.ex_cn: v. 她有幸拥有音乐天赋。
words.en: To be fortunate enough to have something, especially a quality or ability.

words.tr: phrase. 天生具有…的；有幸拥有…的
words.ex: She is blessed with good health.
words.ex_cn: 她有幸拥有健康的身体。
words.en: To be fortunate or lucky to have something.

words.ex: They live in a small bungalow near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一座小平房里。
words.en: A bungalow is a small house, usually having one story.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.tr: phrase. 对…过敏的；对…有变态反应的
words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: Having an allergy to a particular substance or food, causing an adverse reaction when exposed to it.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.ex: He ate a walnut for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一颗胡桃作为健康零食。
words.en: A walnut is the nut of the walnut tree, which has a hard, wrinkled shell and a two-lobed, edible kernel.

words.ex: The squirrel ran up the tree with a nut.
words.ex_cn: 松鼠带着一颗坚果跑上了树。
words.en: A squirrel is a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees and is known for its ability to climb and jump.

words.ex: The apples ripen in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天成熟。
words.en: When crops ripen or when the sun ripens them, they become ripe and ready to eat.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.ex: The stony path made walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这条多石的小路让行走变得困难。
words.en: Something that is stony is covered with stones or contains a lot of stones. It can also describe someone who is unfriendly or unemotional.

words.tr: n. <苏格兰>湖；（狭长的）海湾; n. （Loch）人名；（法）洛克；（英、德、西、匈、捷）洛赫
words.ex: He saw a big loch in Scotland.
words.ex_cn: 他在苏格兰看到了一个大湖。
words.en: A loch is a large area of water in Scotland that is completely or almost completely surrounded by land.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor with a broom.
words.ex_cn: 她用扫帚扫地。
words.en: A broom is a cleaning tool consisting of usually stiff fibers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. It is thus a variety of brush with a long handle.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.ex: He bought new underwear for the summer.
words.ex_cn: 他为夏天买了新的内衣。
words.en: Clothing worn next to the skin under outer clothes.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与……关系良好；与……和睦相处
words.ex: They are on good terms with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: To have a friendly relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与…关系良好；与…相处融洽
words.ex: She is on good terms with her neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 她与邻居关系良好。
words.en: Having a friendly relationship with someone.

words.tr:
n. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
v. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
words.ex: The soldier gave a salute to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向军官敬礼。
words.en: If you salute someone, you greet them or show your respect with a formal sign. Soldiers usually salute officers by raising their right hand so that their fingers touch their forehead.

words.ex: The soldier was spying on the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 这名士兵在夜间秘密侦察敌军营地。
words.en: A spy is a person who secretly collects and reports information about the activities, movements, and plans of an enemy or competitor.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.tr: phrase. 怀念……的；对……怀有乡愁的
words.ex: She often finds herself being nostalgic for her childhood days.
words.ex_cn: 她常常发现自己怀念童年的时光。
words.en: To feel a sentimental longing or wistful affection for a period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 对……充满怀念的；对……怀旧的
words.ex: She felt nostalgic for her childhood days.
words.ex_cn: 她怀念她的童年时光。
words.en: Feeling or inspiring nostalgia for something.

words.tr:
v. 倒带；重绕
n. 倒带；重绕
words.ex: He wants to rewind the video to see the part again.
words.ex_cn: 他想倒带视频再看一遍那一部分。
words.en: To wind back a tape or film to an earlier point.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.tr: 短语. 旧日时光；往昔岁月（常用于歌曲名，表达对过去友谊和时光的怀念）
words.ex: As the clock struck midnight, everyone joined in singing 'Auld Lang Syne'.
words.ex_cn: 当钟声敲响午夜，每个人都加入进来唱起了《友谊地久天长》。
words.en: A traditional Scottish song sung at New Year's Eve to remember old friends and times past.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.tr: adj. 光辉的； v. “glow”的现在分词；
words.ex: The glowing sun rose over the hills.
words.ex_cn: 光辉的太阳从山上升起。
words.en: If you describe something as glowing, you mean that it is very positive and enthusiastic.

words.tr:
n. 低语声；嘟哝
v. 低语；咕哝；私下抱怨
words.ex: I heard a murmur from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来低语声。
words.en: A murmur is a low, indistinct, continuous sound, as of a stream or of voices.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.tr: v. 反复地说；重申；重述
words.ex: He reiterate that he is sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他反复地说他很抱歉。
words.en: If you reiterate something, you say it again, usually in order to emphasize it.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.tr:
v. 踩；踏；践踏
n. 脚步声；胎面
words.ex: He tread carefully on the icy path.
words.ex_cn: 他小心地走在结冰的小路上。
words.en: If you tread on something, you put your foot on it when you are walking. The tread of a tyre is the pattern of lines on its surface that prevent it from slipping.

words.ex: The lights went out all at once.
words.ex_cn: 灯一下子全灭了。
words.en: Suddenly; at the same time.

words.tr: adj. 旧的，老的（同old）; n. （Auld）（美）奥尔德（人名）
words.ex: The auld house has stood for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子已经屹立了几个世纪。
words.en: Old; aged.

words.tr: phrase. 使想起；使记起（某事或某人）
words.ex: This song brings my childhood to mind.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: To cause someone to remember something or think of something.

words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.w: from the bottom of one's heart
words.tr: phrase. 出自内心地；真心诚意地
words.uk: frɒm ðə ˈbɒtəm ɒv wʌns hɑːt
words.us: frəm ðə ˈbɑːtəm ʌv wʌnz hɑːrt
words.ex: He thanked her from the bottom of his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他打心眼里感谢她。
words.en: If you say something from the bottom of your heart, you mean that you are sincere and honest about what you are saying.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.tr: phrase. 举办音乐会；举行演唱会
words.ex: The band plans to give concerts in several cities during their tour.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队计划在他们的巡演期间在几个城市举行音乐会。
words.en: To perform music in front of an audience as part of a concert.

words.ex: The plants grow in the conservatory.
words.ex_cn: 植物在温室里生长。
words.en: A conservatory is a room with glass walls and a glass roof, which is built on the side of a house. It is used as a sun lounge or for growing plants. It can also refer to a school where people are trained in music or acting.

words.ex: The soloist played the violin beautifully.
words.ex_cn: 独奏者优美地演奏了小提琴。
words.en: A soloist is a musician or singer who performs a piece of music alone, often as a featured part of a larger performance.

words.ex: His repertoire includes singing, dancing, and acting.
words.ex_cn: 他的全部才能包括唱歌、跳舞和表演。
words.en: A repertoire is all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer or group knows and can perform.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr: 短语. 对...适用；对...来说是真实的
words.ex: It is true of cats that they like to sleep in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 猫喜欢晒太阳，这一点是真实的。
words.en: If something is true of a person or thing, it applies to them or is valid in their case.

words.ex: This rule is true for all numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则对所有数字都成立。
words.en: Applicable or valid in a particular case or situation.

words.ex: They sing a folk song every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上唱一首民歌。
words.en: A folk song is a song that originates in traditional popular culture or that is written in such a style.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He loves reading poetry before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在睡前读诗歌。
words.en: Poetry is the expression of ideas and feelings through the use of distinctive style and rhythm.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.tr: phrase. 赋予…生命；使…有生机
words.ex: He gave life to the old story with his words.
words.ex_cn: 他用话语赋予了这个古老故事新的生命。
words.en: To animate or enliven something, often giving it vitality or energy.

words.ex: The situation here is the same with what happened last year.
words.ex_cn: 这里的情况和去年发生的情况相同。
words.en: To be identical or similar to something or someone else.

words.ex: Your opinion is the same with mine.
words.ex_cn: 你的观点和我的一样。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is identical or very similar to something else.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr: v. 压下；降低；使沮丧；使不活泼；使萧条
words.ex: He depresses the button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下按钮启动机器。
words.en: If something depresses you, it makes you feel sad and disappointed.

words.tr: phrase. 与……分享感受和想法
words.ex: It's important to share feelings and ideas with friends to maintain good relationships.
words.ex_cn: 与朋友分享感受和想法对于维持良好关系非常重要。
words.en: To communicate emotions and thoughts with another person.

words.tr: phrase. 与…取得联系；与…接触；与…建立联系
words.ex: He tried to make contact with his friend by phone.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过电话与朋友取得联系。
words.en: To establish communication or connection with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 大师级音乐家；技艺精湛的音乐家
words.ex: He is considered a master musician in the field of classical music.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是古典音乐领域的大师级音乐家。
words.en: A master musician is someone who has achieved a high level of skill and expertise in music, often recognized as a leading figure in their field.

words.tr: phrase. 创作音乐；谱写乐曲
words.ex: He likes to compose music in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose music is to write and create music, especially as a professional activity.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. 看待；“regard”的现在分词；
words.ex: He sent me an email regarding the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他给我发了一封关于会议的邮件。
words.en: You can use regarding to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.tr:
n. 韵文；
v. 押韵；
words.ex: The poem has a simple rhyme.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗有一段简单的韵文。
words.en: A rhyme is a repetition of similar sounds in the final stressed syllables and any following syllables of two or more words, most often used in poetry.

words.ex: A passer-by helped the old man cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 一位路人帮老人过马路。
words.en: A passer-by is a person who is walking past something, especially when something unusual is happening.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

words.ex: There is a five-minute interval between the two classes.
words.ex_cn: 两节课之间有五分钟的间隔。
words.en: An interval is a period of time between two events or dates.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.ex: He plugged the charger into the socket.
words.ex_cn: 他把充电器插进插座里。
words.en: A socket is a device into which an electric plug can be inserted in order to make a connection in a circuit.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.ex: The car stopped on a side road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车停在了一条小路上。
words.en: A side road is a smaller, less important road that leads off a main road.

words.tr: n. 四重奏；四重唱；四件一套；
words.ex: The quartet played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 四重奏在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A quartet is a group of four people who play musical instruments or sing together.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.tr: phrase. 手摇风琴；一种通过旋转曲柄使装有钉子的圆筒自动演奏音乐的机械风琴
words.ex: The barrel organ played a cheerful tune as people passed by.
words.ex_cn: 手摇风琴在人们经过时演奏了一首欢快的曲子。
words.en: A barrel organ is a mechanical musical instrument consisting of bellows and one or more ranks of pipes, which is played by turning a handle.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.ex: He had a mop of curly hair that always looked messy.
words.ex_cn: 他有一头乱蓬蓬的卷发，总是看起来很凌乱。
words.en: A mop is a tool for cleaning floors, consisting of a bundle of thick strings or a sponge attached to a long handle. As a verb, it means to clean or wipe something with a mop.

words.tr: v. 识别；“spot”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有斑点的；有污点的；
words.ex: I spotted a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我认出树上有一只鸟。
words.en: Something that is spotted has a pattern of spots on it.

words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He eats popcorn at the movie theater.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影院吃爆米花。
words.en: Popcorn is a variety of corn kernel which expands and puffs up when heated.

words.tr: 短语动词. 随着音乐跳舞；比喻受他人操控或顺应某种趋势行动
words.ex: She loves to dance to the music at parties.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在派对上随着音乐跳舞。
words.en: To move one's body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr: n. <美>山区乡村摇滚乐（起源于美国东南部）
words.ex: The band played a lively set of rockabilly tunes.
words.ex_cn: 乐队演奏了一组欢快的山区乡村摇滚乐曲。
words.en: A style of music that combines elements of rock 'n' roll and country music.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.
